Maya: Need a compact launch micro-kit for May 12 webinar. Deliverables: 1 hero stat card (wide), 2 social crops, 1 email header, and a one-slide benchmark summary. Can design take this?
Theo: Yep. Which primary stat should we lead with?
Maya: Use median latency 62ms and cost ~$0.07/1k tokens as the lead facts. Callouts: 'predictable economics' + 'unified runtime'. Keep hero <=10 words.
Priya: Copy variants incoming. Also include CTA link + UTM.
Design-bot: New Figma file created by Theo: "microkit-may12" https://figma.com/file/microkit-may12 node=5
Theo: Visual notes: simple stat block, small sparkline, icon row for latency/cost. Core palette only, Inter var, no drop shadows. Export sizes: 1200x675, 1080x1080, 800x200 (email). PPTX single-slide for sales.
Legal: No absolutes like 'fastest' or 'cheapest'. Add footnote: "See benchmark data" with CSV link in the asset pack.
Ops: Inbound mapping: source=microkit_may12, hidden field kit_variant, route to bench-webinar (APAC->apac-sdr). Confirmed.
Maya: Timeline: first comps by Tue noon, finals Thu EOD. I'll upload CSV & copy to the shared folder. Thanks!
